title: Roads & Rivers
statement: Roads are for travelling. Rivers go with the flow. A second collection came later under one changed word ... Roads or Rivers, where and becomes or, and the crossing becomes a choice.
notes: Chain shows 40 tokens named "Roads and Rivers #N" (1/1s) and 168 edition tokens (156 Traffic, 12 Rivers End); 8 tokens burned. Seed said 36 x 1/1 + 162 editions. Two contracts: the dedicated ERC-721 (0x18bd004e…) holding the 1/1s plus the Traffic and Rivers End editions, and a separate ERC-1155 (0x4a9a1087…) of 19 editions, 1,796 items, 451 holders, listed on OpenSea as "Roads or Rivers" — the 1155 contract carries no name on chain. Only one edition name maps to a 1/1 (The Ford / "Roads and Rivers #26 Ford"); the other 18 stand alone. The Line is 1,259 of the 1,796 items.

contracts.name: Roads or Rivers
contracts.note: Contract exposes no name() on chain; "Roads or Rivers" is the collection name on OpenSea.
